content.description: HipAliens is a collection of 7599 NFT unique digital collectibles living on the Cardano blockchain. Your purchase of a HipAlien NFT works like a membership card and guarantees access to the benefits reserved for members. Each Aliens is unique and programmatically generated by over 100 traits, all carefully treated, but some are rarer than others. The artistic line is essential and minimalist: the lines are strong, the colors are saturated, defined, sharp, the landscapes tend to be flat. It’s a fairy-tale, enchanted world.
